Epic Effects & Enchantments for Your Minecraft Adventures! Take your gameplay to the next level with magical Potion Effects and game-changing Enchantments! Smash through blocks with the Hulk Enchantment, summon gold under your feet with the Gold Effect, and supercharge your weapons with Night Edge. Leave trails of flowers with the Nature Effect, and discover even more wild powers that make exploring, fighting, and building in Minecraft more fun than ever!
